numericLaws: Packed pixels contain two luminance bytes followed by shared blue and red chroma. Derived component is ((198*red-98*luma-43*blue)>>8)+99.

Each coarse/fine cascade has100 stages. Scores accumulate modulo65536, compare as signed halfwords to signed stage thresholds, and dispatch four feature kinds. Fine features use three-pixel strips or a nine-pixel mean.
Coarse final score must exceed23; fine final score must be nonnegative. Face detector final score must exceed-2160; local search final score must be nonnegative. All24 final stages must pass.
Malformed feature kind aborts the scan immediately. Face detector has already reset scratch count and written search settings, but does not copy scratch to destination on this path.
Detector faces advance18 bytes, scale groups52 bytes and views12 bytes. Face orientation0,1,11 searches the upper half;2..4 the right half;5..7 the lower half;8..10 the left half.
Local search appends without resetting. Row-major candidate positions are centered signed fixed-point coordinates divided by caller scale.
Exact duplicate key includes packed scale plus final_score, x and y. First record survives; compaction preserves order.
Score accumulation visits directed pairs and updates both records for each visit. Same-scale neighbors within eight squared scale units contribute their final scores twice.

Nearby suppression uses scale-factor-two eligibility, strict radius-square comparison, accumulated score then signed final score tie-breakers. Exact ties retain both. A negative wrapped distance or limit returns before compaction.

Angles use8192 units per turn. Sine/cosine return4096 amplitude; interpolation truncates toward zero. Gradient classification compares the negative directional projection against zero and returns the low eight bits of its scaled255 result.
